office.//: The 'office' is where your agents live. In passthrough they appear in your real room; seats are positions relative to the office origin (which spawns in front of you when you enter AR). Edit seats to rearrange the room.

//agents: Start empty: on first run the app shows a guided empty state. Add agents visually in the Studio (Roster tab) — it saves to agents.local.json — or copy this file to agents.local.json and add them by hand, e.g.: { "id": "assistant", "name": "Assistant", "emoji": "🤖", "brain": "main", "voice": "<elevenlabs_voice_id>", "avatar": "assets/avatars/your-avatar.vrm", "seat": "center", "tone": "helpful, warm, concise" }
